nodes.label: src/renderer/index.html (renderer HTML shell, CSP, #root)
nodes.rationale: Content-Security-Policy is locked to 'self' with loopback-only exceptions (img/media: blob: + http://127.0.0.1:*, connect: http://127.0.0.1:* and ws:// to localhost/127.0.0.1) so the renderer can consume media from the local stream server while blocking remote origins. React app mounts into div#root via the module script /src/main.tsx.

nodes.label: Build tooling (electron-vite 6, Vite 8; npm dev/typecheck/build/dist)
nodes.rationale: Production bundles go to out/; dist produces a Windows NSIS installer plus a portable build in release/.

nodes.label: Desktop behaviour (frameless chrome, media keys, single instance, open-with)
nodes.norm_label: desktop behaviour (frameless chrome, media keys, single instance, open-with)
nodes.rationale: Frameless chrome, media-key support, single-instance handling, open-with integration and remembered window state.

nodes.label: FFmpeg/FFprobe binaries (ffmpeg-static, ffprobe-static, resources/bin)
nodes.rationale: Development expects the FFmpeg and FFprobe binaries installed by ffmpeg-static and ffprobe-static; packaged builds copy both binaries to resources/bin and use them from there.

nodes.label: FFmpeg compatibility pipeline (remux/transcode to fMP4, MSE streaming)
nodes.norm_label: ffmpeg compatibility pipeline (remux/transcode to fmp4, mse streaming)
nodes.rationale: Everything the browser cannot play natively - MKV/AVI/TS, HEVC, VP9, Opus, multi-track audio and other awkward containers - is remuxed or transcoded to fragmented MP4 and streamed through Media Source Extensions.

nodes.label: Interface (themes, command palette, drawers, context menus, drag-and-drop)
nodes.norm_label: interface (themes, command palette, drawers, context menus, drag-and-drop)
nodes.rationale: Dark and light themes, five accents, command palette (Ctrl+K), queue and media-info drawers, custom context menus, keyboard shortcuts and drag-and-drop.

nodes.label: Zustand state stores (settings, library, player, history, UI)
nodes.norm_label: zustand state stores (settings, library, player, history, ui)
nodes.rationale: Chosen as the state layer; stores cover settings, library, player, history and UI.

nodes.label: BetterVLC (project)
nodes.rationale: VLC-class desktop media player with a calmer, more considered interface; independent project inspired by VLC, not affiliated with or endorsed by VideoLAN. Deliberately does not bind libVLC; VLC's source and installed binaries are used only as behavioural references for parity targets (A-B loop, chapter navigation, track selection, playback speed, snapshots). Licensed MIT.

nodes.label: Deliberate limitations (DRM/Blu-ray, PGS/VobSub, 4K software transcode, URL seekability)
nodes.norm_label: deliberate limitations (drm/blu-ray, pgs/vobsub, 4k software transcode, url seekability)
nodes.rationale: DRM-protected content and Blu-ray menus are out of scope. Bitmap subtitle formats (PGS, VobSub) are detected but cannot be converted to text for the custom overlay. Compatibility playback is software-transcoded, so very high-bitrate 4K files benefit from the resolution cap in Settings. Streaming from a URL depends on FFmpeg's protocol support and the source's seekability.
